items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps oily, sensitive-looking skin comfortable day to day.
A gentler, rinse-off way to smooth the look of texture, used a few nights a week instead of a strong peel.
A light mattifying gel moisturizer to balance shine and support moisture without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily choice for fair, sensitive-looking skin and protects while you smooth texture.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel because it is very strong to start with when skin looks sensitive and has never used exfoliants; begin with LL-102 two nights a week, then build up only if skin stays comfortable. Use the cleanser LL-101 otherwise, apply the gel moisturizer morning and night, and wear sunscreen every morning.
